regions.today: It will be rather cloudy this morning with outbreaks of rain and drizzle across the north of the province, but becoming mostly dry by the afternoon, with some sunny spells developing. Cloud will increase again in the evening with rain gradually spreading from the northwest. A warm and humid day, with highest temperatures of 20 to 24 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Cloudy tonight with rain, drizzle and mist in the northwest spreading southeastwards early on, becoming lighter and patchier as they do. Drier conditions will follow towards morning. Mild with lowest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees in light to moderate westerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Generally cloudy to start tomorrow with the odd light shower around. It will brighten up from the northwest through the afternoon with sunny spells developing. Cooler than recent days with highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees in light to moderate westerly breezes.
